nv_definition: 1 - Tr(rho^2) over single NV electron spin density matrix
photonic_equivalent: A_leak_photonic = 1 - Tr(rho_AB^2) over two-photon Bell-pair density matrix

structural_basis: Standard quantum-information generalization from single-qubit to two-qubit purity loss; no free parameter
public_source_vocabulary: Quantum-optics tomography (RFC 9340 entanglement quality; standard quantum-state tomography literature)
falsifier_statement: Two-photon Bell-pair tomography that does NOT produce a purity-loss value matching 1 - Tr(rho_AB^2) within standard tomography uncertainty would falsify the A_leak photonic identification

photonic_definition: Time for entanglement fidelity F(t) to characteristically decay; standard quantum-network metric

public_source_vocabulary: RFC 9340 quantum-network coherence terminology; standard entanglement-decay literature; Qunnect tau_ent reporting

photonic_equivalent: t_fire_photonic = first time A_leak_photonic(t) crosses A_side = 1/24 under entanglement decay characterized by tau_ent
photonic_definition: Same threshold-crossing definition; substitute tau_ent for T2
